long_biography.plain_text:
Steven W. Hudson co-founded Hudson Capital Group with his father, Harris "Whit" Hudson, and turned the Fort Lauderdale firm toward acquiring, developing and managing real estate. Its work has included downtown commercial assemblages, mixed-use plans and a proposed luxury hotel on Las Olas Boulevard.

Raised in Fort Lauderdale, Hudson studied business economics at Southern Methodist University before building his career in the city. His public service reflects the outdoor interests that also shape his civic profile. Appointed to the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission in 2019, he later became vice chairman. He also chairs Broward Workshop and has served conservation, animal-welfare and community organisations.
